Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Two hoses together fill a hot tub in 4 hours, and the big one alone is 6 hours faster than the small one. How long does each take alone? Rates add as fractions — and one of the two answers you get is impossible.两根水管一起 4 小时灌满一个热水池，大水管单独灌比小水管快 6 小时。各自单独要多久？效率是分数相加——而你算出的两个答案里有一个不可能。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  1. NPVs first; then multiply EVERY term (whole numbers too) by the LCD.先写不允许值；再把每一项（包括整数项）都乘以公分母。
  2. An answer equal to an NPV is extraneous — reject it; all rejected → no solution.等于不允许值的解是增根，舍去；全部舍去 → 无解。
  3. Work: rates add, t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​. Travel: time =speeddistance​.工作问题：效率相加，t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​。行程问题：时间 =速度路程​。
t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​
t=vd​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Turning a work or travel story into an equation把工作／行程问题列成方程

The equation comes from rates or times, not from the hours given, so students add the wrong things.方程来自效率或时间的关系，而不是题目里的小时数本身，所以常加错东西。

  1. Pipe A: x h, B: x+5 h, together 6 h → rates x1​, x+51​, 61​A 管 x 小时，B 管 x+5 小时，合作 6 小时 → 效率 x1​, x+51​, 61​
  2. x1​+x+51​=61​
  3. ×6x(x+5): 6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0两边乘 6x(x+5)：6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0
  4. x=10 (reject −3): A 10 h, B 15 hx=10（舍去 −3）：A 用 10 小时，B 用 15 小时
Try试一试
A drone flies 12 km into a 4 km/h headwind and 12 km back with the wind, 1.6 h in all. Find its speed in still air.一架无人机逆风（风速 4 km/h）飞 12 km，再顺风飞回 12 km，共用 1.6 小时。求它在无风时的速度。
Answer答案
s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h (reject −1).s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h（舍去 −1）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  • 1+x2−412​: the 1 stays 1 ✗ → it becomes x2−4.1+x2−412​ 里的 1 不乘 ✗ → 它要变成 x2−4。
  • Together time =t1​+t2​ ✗ → add the RATES; together is faster than either alone.合作时间 =t1​+t2​ ✗ → 应该把效率相加；合作比任何一个人单干都快。
🎯
In word problems, make a small table (rate or speed, time) before writing the equation.应用题先列个小表（效率或速度、时间），再列方程。

quiz.q: Solve x3​=x+45​.解方程 x3​=x+45​。
quiz.hint: Cross-multiply: 3(x+4)=5x.交叉相乘：3(x+4)=5x。
quiz.ans: x=6
quiz.why: NPVs x=0,−4. 3x+12=5x, so x=6.不允许值 x=0,−4。3x+12=5x，x=6。

quiz.q: Solve x−1x​=x−11​+2.解方程 x−1x​=x−11​+2。
opts: x=1
x=−1
x=3
no solution无解
quiz.hint: What is the NPV?不允许值是多少？
quiz.ans: No solution (x=1 is extraneous)无解（x=1 是增根）
quiz.why: x=1+2(x−1) gives x=1, which is the NPV. No solution.x=1+2(x−1) 得 x=1，正是不允许值。无解。

quiz.q: Solve x−x6​=1.解方程 x−x6​=1。
quiz.hint: Multiply by x.两边乘 x。
quiz.ans: x=3 or x=−2x=3 或 x=−2
quiz.why: x2−6=x → x2−x−6=0 → (x−3)(x+2)=0. Neither is the NPV 0.x2−6=x → x2−x−6=0 → (x−3)(x+2)=0。都不是不允许值 0。

quiz.q: Solve x+2x​−x2−48​=x−21​.解方程 x+2x​−x2−48​=x−21​。
opts: x=5 or x=−2
x=5
x=−2

quiz.ans: x=5 (x=−2 is extraneous)x=5（x=−2 是增根）

quiz.q: The sum of a number and its reciprocal is 310​. Find the number.一个数与它的倒数之和为 310​，求这个数。
quiz.hint: x+x1​=310​; multiply by 3x.x+x1​=310​；两边乘 3x。
quiz.ans: 3 or 31​3 或 31​
quiz.why: 3x2+3=10x → 3x2−10x+3=0 → (3x−1)(x−3)=0.3x2+3=10x → 3x2−10x+3=0 → (3x−1)(x−3)=0。

quiz.q: A cyclist rides 30 km. If she rode 5 km/h faster, the trip would take 1 h less. Find her actual speed.一名骑车人骑行 30 km。如果她每小时快 5 km，就能少用 1 小时。求她实际的速度。
quiz.hint: v30​−v+530​=1.v30​−v+530​=1。
quiz.ans: 10 km/h
quiz.why: Multiply by v(v+5): 30(v+5)−30v=v(v+5) → v2+5v−150=0 → (v+15)(v−10)=0.乘以 v(v+5)：30(v+5)−30v=v(v+5) → v2+5v−150=0 → (v+15)(v−10)=0。

quiz.q: A boat goes 24 km upstream and 24 km back in 5 h. The current is 2 km/h. Find the boat’s speed in still water.一艘船逆流行 24 km 再顺流返回 24 km，共用 5 小时。水流速度 2 km/h，求船在静水中的速度。
quiz.hint: v−224​+v+224​=5.v−224​+v+224​=5。
quiz.ans: 10 km/h
quiz.why: 24(v+2)+24(v−2)=5(v2−4) → 5v2−48v−20=0 → (5v+2)(v−10)=0.24(v+2)+24(v−2)=5(v2−4) → 5v2−48v−20=0 → (5v+2)(v−10)=0。

quiz.q: A junior hockey team rents ice for $378 and splits the cost equally among its players. When 3 more players join, each player pays $3 less. (a) Write an equation for the original number of players x and solve it. (b) Explain which solutions are rejected and why. (c) Verify with the actual share per player before and after.一支青少年冰球队租冰场花 $378，由队员平均分摊。又有 3 名队员加入后，每人少付 $3。(a) 为原来的队员人数 x 列方程并求解。(b) 说明哪个解要舍去，为什么。(c) 用加入前后每人实际分摊的钱验证。
quiz.hint: Multiply by the LCD x(x+3). The equation reduces to x2+3x−378=0.乘公分母 x(x+3)，方程化为 x2+3x−378=0。
quiz.ans: (a) x378​−x+3378​=3 gives x=18; (b) x=−21 is rejected (people cannot be negative); (c) $21 before, $18 after.(a) x378​−x+3378​=3 得 x=18；(b) x=−21 舍去（人数不能为负）；(c) 加入前每人 $21，加入后 $18。
quiz.why: Original share x378​, new share x+3378​, so x378​−x+3378​=3 with x=0,−3.原来每人 x378​，现在每人 x+3378​，所以 x378​−x+3378​=3，x=0,−3。
